integrity: The mathematical proof is analytic for all connected positive-weight graphs; 612 exact rational assertions supplement but do not certify the infinite family. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Comparison concerns unmodified one-draw variance, not computational cost, tails, Rademacher probes, or variance-reduced methods. The exact spectral identities are previously known; the graph-uniform extremal theorem is derived from them. Publication-priority uncertainty remains and independent validation has not been performed.
title: A sharp 25-vertex boundary for random-forest versus Gaussian inverse-trace variance
